subject: Final station art verified: integrate Four Locks props; state readability needs live QA
body:
# Station-art delivery review:2 October2026

Reviewed final ART-STATIONS local manifest and delivery. Independent file verification:13 assets,27 mappings,239666 bytes, zero runtime hash/byte/QA-path failures. Visually inspected identities-green.png, hex-hero-composition.png and number-states.png. Seven distinct coherent painted silhouettes meet the9fo material direction; all five Four Locks identities exist and are recognisable. Review approves proceeding to scoped renderer integration, not final visual acceptance.

State variants currently use small upright badge overlays on unchanged painted bases, including damaged. Their actual gameplay legibility and comprehensibility remain a concern requiring map-scale screenshots, accessible labels and appropriate visible effect. Do not claim damaged/held readability from the isolated contact sheet. Independent states must stack correctly; no invented charge/integrity for control/alcove. Keep live labels/values, exact logical geometry and independent objective tree.

Existing builder should consume final station-art-batch-manifest.json, verify exact hashes with import gate and wire only current Four Locks entities first. Renderer lookup by family/entity avoids immutable blueprint certificate changes. Inspect idle/charged/held/damaged combinations and inactive/active/corrupted control, unprepared/prepared/held alcove at phone/tablet/desktop and min/native/maxzoom. Require a visible refinement if badge-only states are ambiguous; coordinate asset changes with ART-STATIONS writer rather than overwrite its files. Other family assets may remain staged while family production is QA-gated.

Player recovery owner reports actual isolated-controller browser win/replay/loss evidence and restored UI. Those reports are not independently accepted here; integrated App/account/profile/build roundtrip and scrum UX visual review remain open. Assets complete does not mean game accepted. No automation restart, public release or gameplay change authorised.
